subject: UnitTestFrameworkPkg: Increment handle key outside if block
reasons: This is a paired fix with 8f28978843 (MdeModulePkg/Core: Increment handle key outside if block) applying the identical structural change to the UnitTest stub
The change moves two statements (gHandleDatabaseKey++; Handle->Key = gHandleDatabaseKey;) from inside an if-block to outside it

While the same fix is applied in two places, the change is a logic/control-flow fix that requires understanding of the surrounding code structure - Coccinelle could theoretically express this but it would be fragile given the if/else context
Low repetitiveness overall: only two locations in the entire codebase needed this fix, making it a low-value Coccinelle candidate
